methodology.frameworkOrder: Alternating within paired rounds; one daemon at a time
methodology.startup: Parent process spawn to daemon listening/ready IPC; warm OS/module caches; includes native CLI health detection
methodology.memory: Median of five IPC process.memoryUsage samples 100 ms apart; warmed after 20 full snapshots; no forced GC
methodology.quietLatency: 300 serial keep-alive responses per endpoint per round after 10 connection warmups; high-resolution parent performance.now to response end; no other load
methodology.sse: 100 sequential fresh connections per round; time to complete first saved-state event; no generated tokens
methodology.footprint: Unique installed third-party production dependency closure including installed optional dependencies; sum of logical file lengths excluding nested node_modules and symlinks; excludes workspace sources, dev dependencies and Electron; not packaged app size
